title: 第7章 打脸第8章 商业鬼才
slug: 剑道圣体的我只想躺平
content_zh:
秦峰感觉自己对这一剑的领悟已经达到了极境，这是他从未有过的感觉。
仿佛这一剑能牵动天地大势一般，有一种俯瞰众生的感觉。
大成之后是化境，极境，还有那传说中的归一境，到这三个境界跟努力一点关系也没有。
有的人天赋卓绝，几十年就能达到，有的数千年甚至穷其一生也无法达到。
大成之前靠努力，大成之后完全靠天赋，上天就是这么不公平。
秦峰心情激动，那岂不是说自己的天赋比六老祖还要高，这就是剑道圣体，无敌呀！
应该庆祝一下！
于是他拿出之前四长老送的梨花醉豪饮一口，心情舒畅。
这一幕恰巧被旁边的一青年看到，他上前道：“你不知道藏书阁不能饮酒吗？”
这人是重剑一脉的袁武，也是执法殿弟子，之前秦峰打伤于川，让他们饱受嘲笑。
刚才看到秦峰，就立刻过来找茬。
秦峰看了一眼袁武，不屑道：“四师伯也喝酒，你怎么不去管他？”
“他要是不喝，我就不喝！”
袁武气愤道：“你……”
他半天没说出话，最后气愤的离开。
秦峰又灌了两口，有些不舍得将酒收了起来，好酒还得回去配上火锅喝才有味道。
要是喝光了，就有点浪费了，也不知道小师妹现在的身体怎么样了，都已经昏迷好几天了。
这些年来，小师妹每次昏迷的时间都比之前长一些。
就凭小师妹没事就给自己找酒喝，还冒着危险帮自己做任务，他就必须得找到那个下蛊之人，把他的脑袋拧下来。
还是得提升一下修为，师父那种高手，去到巫族的领地都差点没回来，自己现在修为肯定不够。

先去买符纸吧，当务之急赚点钱才是正经。
他准备离开，当来到门口的时候就发现测技石旁边围了一群人。
还传来一阵阵的叫好声：“袁武师兄果然天赋异禀，居然不到百年就把重剑术练到了大成境界。”
“真是我重剑一脉的未来之星啊！”
“是啊，是啊，袁武师兄威武！”
袁武道：“大家都好好修炼，只要足够勤奋，都有机会的。”
“虽然不会像我这么快，但总归都能达到大成的。”
那名弟子道：“师兄说的没错，掌门现在忙于事务，无心收徒，目前三峰中我们重剑峰算是最顶盛的一脉了。”
另一名弟子道：“咱们这么多人，跟影剑锋分配的资源一样也就算了，杀剑锋就那么三绝居然跟我们分配的资源也一样，真不知道掌门怎么想的。”
另一人附和：“就是，那杀剑三绝简直就是个笑话，一个战斗狂，一个酒痴，一个病秧子。”
袁武道：“所以我们一定要争气，在我们这一代要碾压他们。”
正在这时后面传来秦峰的声音：“背后议论别人是很不好的。”
众人都吓得一哆嗦，看到秦峰来了都站在了袁武身后，一副同仇敌忾的样子。
袁武道：“秦峰，这里可是藏书阁，你想怎么样？”
content_en:
Qin Feng felt that his understanding of this sword had reached an extreme level, which was something he had never felt before.
As if this sword can affect the general trend of the world, there is a feeling of overlooking all living beings.
After Dacheng, there is the Transformation Realm, the Ultimate Realm, and the legendary Guiyi Realm. Reaching these three realms has nothing to do with hard work.
Some people are so talented that they can achieve it in a few decades, while some people can't achieve it in thousands of years or even in their lifetime.
Before Dacheng, it depends on hard work, and after Dacheng, it depends entirely on talent. God is so unfair.
Qin Feng was excited. Doesn't that mean that his talent is higher than that of the Sixth Ancestor? This is the holy body of swordsmanship, invincible!
It should be celebrated!
So he took out the pear blossom that the fourth elder had given him and drank it drunkenly, feeling comfortable.
This scene happened to be seen by a young man next to him. He stepped forward and said, "Don't you know that drinking is not allowed in the library?"
This man is Yuan Wu of the Epee lineage and a disciple of the Law Enforcement Hall. Qin Feng injured Yu Chuan before, causing them to suffer ridicule.
When I saw Qin Feng just now, I immediately came over to find trouble.
Qin Feng glanced at Yuan Wu and said disdainfully: "The fourth uncle is also drinking, why don't you care about him?"
"If he doesn't drink, I won't drink!"
Yuan Wu said angrily: "You..."
He didn't say anything for a long time, and finally left angrily.
Qin Feng took two more sips and put the wine away with some reluctance. Good wine must be paired with hot pot to taste.
If you drink all of it, it will be a bit of a waste. I don’t know how the little junior sister’s body is now. She has been in a coma for several days.
Over the years, the junior sister's coma time has been longer than before.
Just because the little junior sister found him a drink when he had nothing to do, and even risked his life to help him with tasks, he had to find the person who had poisoned him and twist his head off.
You still need to improve your cultivation level. For a master like Master, he almost didn't come back from the Witch Clan's territory. His current cultivation level is definitely not enough.
Let's buy talisman paper first. The most important thing is to make some money.
He was about to leave, but when he came to the door, he found a group of people gathered around the skill testing stone.
There were also waves of applause: "Senior Brother Yuan Wu is really talented. He has mastered the epee technique to a great level in less than a hundred years."
"He is truly the future star of my epee lineage!"
"Yes, yes, senior brother Yuan Wu is mighty!"
Yuan Wudao: "Everyone should practice hard. As long as you work hard enough, you will have a chance."
"Although it won't be as fast as me, you can still reach great success."
The disciple said: "Senior brother is right. The leader is currently busy with affairs and has no intention of recruiting disciples. Currently, our Ceylon Peak is the most prosperous among the three peaks."
Another disciple said: "With so many of us, it's okay to be allocated the same resources as Shadow Jianfeng. However, the Three Ultimates of Killing Jianfeng are allocated the same resources as us. I really don't know what the leader is thinking."
Another person echoed: "That's right, the three sword-killing skills are just a joke, a fighting maniac, a drunkard, and a sick man."
Yuan Wudao: "So we must strive for success and crush them in our generation."
At this moment, Qin Feng's voice came from behind: "It's not good to talk about others behind their backs."
Everyone trembled with fear and stood behind Yuan Wu when they saw Qin Feng coming, as if they shared the same hatred.
Yuan Wudao: "Qin Feng, this is the library, what do you want?"
